svg.title: Stack: from pixels to bytes
svg.desc: Five layers, top to bottom. Interface: Qt 6, QML, Qt Widgets, Win32 / GDI, CEF, Duilib (seen in GDownload). Media & vision: FFmpeg, NVENC · AMF · QSV, OpenGL, libVLC, ncnn, YOLO, OCR (seen in VideoHardwareEncoding). Concurrency: C++17 / 20, coroutines, Boost.Asio, thread pools, async I/O (seen in ed2k-engine-cpp and ThreadPool). Protocols: HTTP, BitTorrent, eD2k / Kad, aria2, Tars / JCE (seen in ed2k-engine-cpp and tarswire). Binaries: x86 / x64 asm, PE internals, static analysis, debugging, DLL proxying (seen in 010Forge and uninstalltool-keygen-cpp). Toolchain: CMake, vcpkg, GitHub Actions, Python, TypeScript, Lua.
